_comment: Per-machine override (rewritten 2026-10-18): Ornith orchestrates and verifies; builders run on Command Code (power); reviewers and analysts on the Claude plan (sonnet/opus, backend claude); local Qwen models keep mechanical and persona work. Local choices go through the LlamaStash proxy :11435 (no probes: its API key is not in ~/.hermes/.env). Previous: sdlc-models.json.bak-2026-10-18.

fast.use_for: Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B (MoE, ~76 tok/s). Code-heavy and mechanical work: implementation and test edits with a clear spec, UI code, running commands and reporting raw output. Fastest; weakest at judgment and long-range reasoning.

balanced.use_for: Qwen3.8-27B (dense, 131k context). Generalist writing and analysis: requirements, product, UX, documentation, persona exploration, performance and database analysis. Loads on first use, so the first call is slow.

deep.use_for: Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B (Q8_0, MoE, thinking on, 128k context). The lead model: orchestration, architecture, security, root cause, release judgment, QA verification. Spend it where judgment decides the outcome.

power.use_for: Command Code bridge (deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro via cmd -p, can edit and run). Strong cloud implementer for software, UI and database work; also the escalation tier when local models are down. Content leaves the machine.

sonnet.use_for: Claude Sonnet via your Claude plan (claude -p, read-only: Read/Grep/Glob, no shell, no MCP). Strong general reasoning, code review, product/UX/requirements/writing and release work. Counts against plan limits; content leaves the machine.

opus.use_for: Claude Opus via your Claude plan (claude -p, read-only: Read/Grep/Glob, no shell, no MCP). The strongest reviewer: security review, architecture, hard root-cause and incident judgment. Heaviest on plan limits; content leaves the machine.

opus-video.use_for: Claude Opus via your Claude plan for video work: read-only plus ffmpeg and ffprobe only (no other shell command, no MCP). Cannot run Whisper or video_edit, so captions need a transcript passed in.

opus-ui.use_for: Claude Opus via your Claude plan for UI implementation: reads and edits files in the working directory and runs only tests, build, lint and tsc (no other shell command, no MCP).
